owned_source.name: ASJP v21 CLDF/CLTS external Q20P001 comparator
owned_source.capacity: Twelve source lists,39–40 isolated basic-vocabulary forms each; reported18–35 token inventories. These are report metadata, not a new census.
limits: Modern/special-purpose basic vocabulary, not representative running text or medieval pronunciation.
No independently supplied binary segment classification was identified in the bounded audit; use source/CLTS feature metadata, not improvised IPA classifications.
Original Q20P001 native fit failed Kartvelian specificity. No native Q20 payload or target data was reopened.
Existing corpus is owned and pinned; a claim that no pronunciation data exist would be false.

proposed_positive_contrast.contract: A pinned independently classified pronunciation dataset, such as the official dictionary root is considering, tests recovery of its independently labeled C/V segments after opaque relabeling. Existing ASJP can serve only if independent segment labels and capacity are adequate.
proposed_positive_contrast.smallest_exact_question: Does the unchanged signed-cut objective admit a one-phone flip improving on true supplied C/V? A witness excludes exact optimum identification without a full optimizer.
proposed_positive_contrast.approximate_question: Approximate class recovery needs an actual frozen estimator plus comparison to independent truth; a one-flip certificate cannot answer it. Report balanced type-class recovery and frequency-weighted recovery separately, with uncertainty or rare-class limitations.
leakage_rules: Split by base lexeme, keeping alternative pronunciations together.
Predeclare canonical pronunciation or total per-lexeme weight1; do not multiply variants unnoticed.
Stress stripping only via official phone inventory; unknown symbols remain errors/unscorable, not guessed classes.
Fix orientation from training truth or explicitly use a complement-invariant score; do not choose orientation per held subset.
proposed_positive_contrast.limits: Modern dictionary pronunciation is not medieval source language, running speech or evidence of Voynich phonemes. No syllable boundaries inferred from dictionary phones alone.

proposed_negative_contrast.purpose: Measure specificity of the same structural positive criterion against actual nonphonetic content-bearing records, not merely shuffled characters.

control_A.construction: Three ordered SET(register,value) instructions serialize as R V R V R V using disjoint opaque inventories for register IDs and literal values. Exactly decode every instruction pair; overwrite order retained in message. Inventories and dataset choices fixed before outcomes.
control_A.analytic_prediction: After removal of the two endpoints, V R V R has3 crossings and bag expectation2, so excess per edge1/3. Identities and repetitions do not alter role pattern.
control_A.scope: This is a proof that alternation alone can be positive for nonphonetic instructions; not proof that the learned maximum uniquely identifies these roles on every finite sample.

control_B.construction: Three ordered assignments; each address is a path of1or2 address symbols, each value a1or2-digit sequence from a disjoint value alphabet. Field lengths independently equiprobable, fixed before any score. Role changes delimit fields; global opaque bijection hides symbol names.
control_B.content: Ordered path and value digit sequences decode exactly; no phonetics. Register paths and value integers are source-defined, not manuscript meanings.
control_B.sampling: Root must freeze inventories, leading-zero convention or treat value as literal digit sequence, seed, train/test record counts and weighting before generation. Do not tune runs or select favorable seeds after a phoneme result.
control_B.purpose: Avoid a negative suite containing only perfectly alternating records; evaluate the same test on a nonphonetic grammar with within-role runs.

proposed_negative_contrast.reporting: A negative structural positive is a false positive only for an explicitly claimed phonetic-origin decision rule. High recovery of procedural roles is correct role recovery, not a phoneme mistake by itself. Never equate label recovery on known positive data with generic phonetic-origin discrimination.

identifiability_limit: A whole-word lookup mechanism can produce identical strings and thus identical output statistics without sound computations. Controls can establish sensitivity/specificity against fixed mechanisms, never every possible nonphonetic writer.
